plan-for-signing-a-bundle.text: Issue 639. One pull request, two slices of at most 90 minutes each.

decisions.text: The bundle is JSON, version 1, signers by address (public), effects as untrusted plain lines. Approved by the desk.

slices.text: Codec and witness: the bundle module, the detached witness helper, the fixture and the unit specs.

gate.text: Existing hosted commands, each as its step runs it. In offchain/: nix run .#cage-tests -- --match Bundle, the same with Sign, nix run .#lint, nix build .#component-build. At the root: nix run .#cli-flags-check, nix run .#cli-flags-controls, nix run .#wallet-vault-controls, and inside nix develop just lint and just io-ownership-check; python3 tools/narrate.py --check when documentation changes; nix run ./offchain#registry-cli-build-graph-check. Every run goes through a memory-capped, time-bounded scope with stdin closed.
